step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows a machine learning pipeline split into Training and Inference sections. Training uses an S3 bucket feeding training data into a GPU Kubernetes cluster on EC2, which outputs trained models to another S3 bucket. Inference uses ALB as an entry point directing requests to a proxy ECS container. The proxy queries DynamoDB for dynamic routing IPs/services before proxying requests to target ECS Services (Blue/Green). New ECS deployments trigger CloudWatch Events, invoking a Lambda function to update DynamoDB with service IP mappings. EC2 Spot instances managed via Spotinst support the ECS cluster.
